description: Import an existing non-photorealistic fictional character illustration (anime, 2D/3D cartoon, pixel art, fantasy digital painting, VTT token art; PNG/JPG/WebP, 256–4096 px, max 5 MB) from an https:// URL or base64 data URI for 0 credits, returning an assetId (ast_...) ready for create_talking_video. Camera photographs and photorealistic human likenesses are strictly blocked by EXIF and automated vision screening. Requires confirmFictional=true and Authorization: Bearer avs_...

confirmFictional.description: Must be true: confirms this image is a fictional, stylized character illustration and NOT a photograph or likeness of a real person.

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded PNG, JPG, or WebP character illustration (raw base64 or data:image/...;base64,... URI, max 5 MB). Provide either imageUrl or imageBase64.

imageUrl.description: Public https:// URL of a PNG, JPG, or WebP stylized character illustration (max 5 MB). Provide either imageUrl or imageBase64.

label.description: Optional character name or short description (up to 160 chars), e.g. "Bramwell Copperbraid — Dwarven Runesmith".

name: import_character_portrait
title: Import Stylized Fictional Character Illustration
